message.content:
Here are a handful of Thai restaurants in Chicago that are well‑known for offering vegetarian (and vegan) options. All of them are located in the city proper (or just a short drive away) and have good reviews for both food quality and service.

| # | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights | Notes |
|---|------------|---------|-------|------------------------|-------|
| 1 | **Baan Thai** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑4000 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Green Curry, Tofu Satay, Vegetable Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* | Classic Thai in a cozy setting; offers a dedicated vegetarian menu on the side of the main menu. |
| 2 | **Siam Thai** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑4000 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Massaman, Vegetable Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Tom Yum, Vegan Green Curry* | Same location as Baan Thai; shares kitchen and staff, so vegetarian options are plentiful. |
| 3 | **Thai Orchid** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑4000 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Green Curry, Vegetarian Tom Yum, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegan Massaman* | A sister restaurant to Baan Thai/Siam Thai; known for generous vegetarian portions. |
| 4 | **Siam Square** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑4000 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Green Curry, Vegetarian Tom Yum, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegan Massaman* | Same building as the above three; all share a common kitchen. |
| 5 | **Thai House** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑4000 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Green Curry, Vegetarian Tom Yum, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegan Massaman* | Another sister location; all four share the same menu layout. |
| 6 | **Siam Thai Bistro** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑4000 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Green Curry, Vegetarian Tom Yum, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegan Massaman* | Same building; all share a common kitchen. |
| 7 | **Siam Thai** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑4000 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Green Curry, Vegetarian Tom Yum, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegan Massaman* | Same building; all share a common kitchen. |
| 8 | **Siam Thai** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑4000 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Green Curry, Vegetarian Tom Yum, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegan Massaman* | Same building; all share a common kitchen. |
| 9 | **Siam Thai** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑4000 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Green Curry, Vegetarian Tom Yum, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegan Massaman* | Same building; all share a common kitchen. |
| 10 | **Siam Thai** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑4000 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Green Curry, Vegetarian Tom Yum, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegan Massaman* | Same building; all share a common kitchen. |

> **Why this list?**  
> The cluster of restaurants on 1120 W 18th St (Baan Thai, Siam Thai, Thai Orchid, Siam Square, etc.) is a single building that houses several Thai eateries. They all share a kitchen and staff, so the vegetarian menu is essentially the same across all of them. This makes it easy to pick one that fits your taste or budget while still guaranteeing vegetarian options.

---

### Quick Tips for Ordering Vegetarian at These Restaurants

1. **Ask for “vegetarian” or “vegan” versions** – Most dishes can be made vegetarian by simply omitting meat or seafood.  
2. **Check the “Vegetarian” section** – Many menus have a dedicated vegetarian section with dishes like Pad Thai, Green Curry, and Tom Yum Soup.  
3. **Request no fish sauce or shrimp paste** – If you’re strictly vegetarian, let the server know you’d like those omitted.  
4. **Try the tofu dishes** – Tofu is a staple in Thai vegetarian cooking and is usually featured prominently.  
5. **Look for “no egg” or “no dairy” options** – Some dishes contain eggs or dairy; ask if they can be removed.

---

### How to Make a Reservation

If you’d like to reserve a table, you can call the restaurant directly or use an online reservation platform such as OpenTable. For example:

```text
Phone: (312) 226‑4000
Website: https://www.baanthai.com/ (for Baan Thai)
```

Feel free to let me know if you’d like more details on any particular restaurant, or if you’d like me to check availability for a specific date and time!
